title: Glint 9x9 (Chaos construction/Firefly)
author: dumediat
rules:
This puzzle is part of the puzzle pack Chaotic Construction by the Sudoku Skunkworks. Please check it out!

For those not familiar with Firefly (Hotaru Beam) rules, there are more visual explanations available on puzz.link. If you want to start with a 6x6 puzzle with this rule set, that can be found here: Glint 6x6.

Ratings, comments, and feedback are much appreciated! Please feel free to reach out to me on Discord if you have any comments or questions. Please also feel free to try my other puzzles here.

Rules:

• Chaos construction: Divide the grid into regions of 9 orthogonally connected cells each, such that every cell is part of exactly one region. Place the digits 1 to 9 exactly once in each row, column and region.

• Fireflies: From each white circle, draw a line to another circle (possibly itself) to create a connected network. Lines must start at the attached black dot, move horizontally or vertically between cell
centers and cannot branch or overlap, go through other circles or connect between two black dots.

• Turns: A digit in a circle indicates the number of turns its line makes. Along each line, a cell with a turn must be in a different region than the cell immediately before it.
